name: Back Alley
summary: Partnership trick-taking game where hand size shrinks from 13 to 1 then grows back, with random trump and combined team bids.
rules_text: Four players in fixed partnerships opposite. Use 52 cards plus big and little jokers. Big joker is highest trump, little second. Deal 13 cards each first hand, then 12,11...1, then 1 up to 13 again for 25 hands. Turn next undealt card for trump; if joker, no trump and holder of other joker replaces it. Clockwise bidding, one bid each: pass (0), a number up to cards-1, or board (win all tricks). Team target is sum of partners' numbers; board overrides numbers. If all pass, redeal same size. Play: highest bidder leads, last board bidder leads if multiple boards. Must follow suit, otherwise any card. Highest trump wins, else highest of led suit. Cannot lead trump unless broken or you bid board. If big joker led everyone must play highest trump if able; if little joker led lowest trump. Score: if bid made, 5 per bid trick +1 per overtrick, else -5 per bid. Board = 10 per trick if all taken else -10 per trick, doubled for double board etc.
